parameters.content:
**Loan status notification.** Convex posts a signed JSON body here when a loan changes status. The signature and timestamp are checked first (401 on a bad signature, 400 on an invalid payload or empty recipient), a repeated event id is acknowledged without a second email, and the recipient gets one email. A failed send answers 500 so Convex retries later; the event id is only remembered after the email went out.

**Known limit.** Processed event ids live in workflow static data, which n8n saves only when an execution ends and the last writer wins. Two deliveries of the same event within a few seconds can therefore both send. The email retries are kept short (2 tries, 3 s apart) so the worst case stays well inside the backend's 30 s timeout and its own retry spacing; a duplicate email is accepted as the residual risk.
